aboutHtml:
About the Project

Cuisine of Desires is a website prototype created by Group 4 for ENG 11 as a creative response to Gabriela Lee's short story Hunger.

Our work takes the form of a satirical chocolate chip cookie recipe. Through its ingredients, procedures, and video tutorial, we explore different meanings of hunger and desire.

The website title, creative concept, and final wording are subject to group approval.
